question: Who is the 25th Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4,

The correct answer is __**Rajiv Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rajiv Kumar** is the 25th Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India, appointed on **15 May 2022**.
 
• He succeeded **Sushil Chandra** as the Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• Rajiv Kumar has been serving in various administrative capacities, including roles in the Ministry of Finance and Department of Personnel and Training.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner is responsible for overseeing elections for the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice President in India.
 
• Rajiv Kumar played a significant role in implementing electoral reforms and ensuring transparency in the election process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI)**

 
 
• Established in **1950**, the ECI is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for conducting free and fair elections in India.
 
• The ECI consists of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and two Election Commissioners (ECs).
 
• It operates under Article **324** of the Constitution of India.
 
 
 
• **Roles and Powers of the Chief Election Commissioner**
 
 
• Ensures the conduct of free and fair elections at national and state levels.
 
• Issues guidelines for political parties and candidates during elections.
 
• Oversees the implementation of the Model Code of Conduct during elections.
 
• Has quasi-judicial powers to settle disputes related to elections.
 
 
 
• **Electoral Reforms**
 
 
• Introduction of Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) system for transparency.
 
• Digitization and simplification of voter registration processes.
 
• Reforms aimed at reducing the influence of money and muscle power during elections.
 
 
 
• **Significance of ECI**
 
 
• Plays a vital role in upholding India's democratic values.
 
• Ensures the participation of citizens in the electoral process.
 
• Maintains the integrity of the electoral system.
